profile.en: Peritt is a demon who can manipulate various gases, possessing the ability to change the breath they exhale at will. This unique ability, which allows them to emit different types of gases in response to their emotions, sets them apart even among their own kind. If they focus, they can produce a wide range of gases, but if they breathe unconsciously, they will release miasma gas. As a result, their family has ostracized them, forcing them to wear a mask. However, they grew tired of this and decided to leave for the Human Realm. Although they must be even more mindful of their miasma gas in the Human Realm, they have found that they can wear a small gas mask as a fashionable item, thanks to the punk and gal fashion trends they discovered. Despite their low-tension and downer demeanor, they have a surprisingly good sense of humor and work as a DJ, MC, dancer, or hall girl at various clubs in the dark streets to earn a living. Their ability to produce "high" gases that boost the mood of their customers has earned them a good reputation.
